name: ordo-automation-js-tests
description: JS unit test harness for Ordo_Automation's admin RequireJS/AMD modules (view/adminhtml/web/js). This project is otherwise PHP-only (PHPUnit + Sonar's PHP coverage via clover.xml) - this package.json exists solely to run and measure coverage for the handful of hand-rolled AMD modules under view/**/web/js, which had no test tooling at all before Test/js/ was added. See Test/js/support/README.md for how a module gets loaded under Node without pulling in a full RequireJS runtime.
